impacts.text: It allows a malicious user to directly influence the `markPrice`, which is the source of truth for all PnL and liquidation calculations.
An attacker can prevent their own legitimate liquidation.
This forces the protocol to carry a toxic, insolvent position for longer than it should, increasing the risk of massive bad debt when the position is eventually closed at a much worse price.
This bad debt drains the Insurance Fund and threatens protocol solvency.
This bug turns it into a vector for attack, completely defeating its purpose.

ambiguities: Undermines the core security of the protocol (e_b0d9d40b7620_0017) is a general severity characterization rather than a distinct harmful outcome.
